top_signals.title: Inflation Data, Not Jobs, to Dictate Next Fed Move, Economist Roth Says
top_signals.summary: Stephanie Roth, chief economist at Wolfe Research, says, “the hawkish price action may be taking the print a little too far,” as she examines economic and monetary policy signals from the US August jobs report. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Italy Extends Diesel Tax Cuts to Shield Voters from Price Hikes
top_signals.summary: Italy will extend a tax cut on diesel fuel prices until Sept. 10, as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s government continues to shield consumers ahead of a general election expected next year, according to an Italian official.
